problem: The suite needs a specialist for CI signal integrity: required triggers/jobs/matrix legs must execute under known runtime assumptions and fail visibly instead of being silently skipped or soft-failed.
triggers: CI matrix or runner coverage changes
required validation is skipped or soft-failed
flaky-test retry policy or hosted-runner reproducibility issues
overlap_review: Narrowed from ci-cd-reliability to ci-pipeline-reliability so it stops at trustworthy pre-deployment validation. testing-typescript-systems owns what to test; this skill owns whether CI executes/reports those tests reliably. Wave B release/rollback owns production promotion and recovery.
current_evidence: Phase 11 PR #26 demonstrated the CI problem class before this skill existed. No controlled post-creation behavioral execution has tested whether loading ci-pipeline-reliability improves CI review/repair outcomes.

minimum_criteria: missing required matrix leg or command is identified
workflow/configuration failure is separated from test failure
solution remains pre-deployment and does not claim rollout/rollback safety

limitations: CI can only prove checks that actually executed
hosted runner/infrastructure failures can still occur
green pre-deployment CI does not prove deployment or rollback safety
this skill does not own dependency or action supply-chain policy
promotion_requirements: execute at least one controlled post-creation CI reliability case
show value beyond general testing/debugging guidance
preserve boundary from release/rollback and supply-chain skills
rejection_condition: Merge into testing guidance or retire if real use shows CI signal-integrity guidance is not independently useful.
